body:
We merged current main into this branch (maintainer edits) and marked it ready so it can join the merge train; no changes to your code beyond the merge.

The conflicts came from main's new LinuxCNC post (#2303) and the G86 zero-dwell fix (#2362); both sides' entries are kept:
- `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`, `control_comp.rs`, `wear_comp.rs`, `post_spindle_rule_all.rs`, `crates/post/tests/comp.rs`: stem lists now carry both `linuxcnc` and `mach3`.
- By hand (array lengths and gate-map comments): `crates/post/tests/bore_cycle.rs` - `SECONDS` is now `[&str; 4]` = tormach, grblhal, linuxcnc, mach3, the gate map names both linuxcnc.cps and mach3.cps; main's new `ZERO_DWELL_P0` list (#2362: posts that write `P0` on a zero-dwell G86) is unchanged and does not include mach3, so Mach3 keeps its own behaviour (no P on a zero-dwell G86). `crates/post/tests/dwell_cycles_modal_p.rs` - `POSTS` is now length 7 with both entries; the gate map names both posts.

Quick gate green on 7755370b2 (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, macOS): 704 steps, 0 failed - app + post lib unit tests and every app/post suite the gate map selected, including conformance, control_comp, wear_comp, post_spindle_rule_all, comp, bore_cycle and dwell_cycles_modal_p.

**Verdict: read, not built - needs a maintainer look.**

What was checked (read of head `7755370b2`):
- Clean-room: the header names the public sources (the "Using Mach3Mill"
  manual behaviour and RS-274) and states that no vendor post script
  text was used. The derivation is from our own `grblhal.cps`. Correct.
- The refusal law: G83 with a dwell is refused, not dropped; a cycle
  with no feed is refused; tapping, G41/G42, probing and tilted moves
  are refused by name; the spindle-stopped check runs before each cycle.
  The sticky-P and cycle-as-first-move laws (#2360, #1682) are carried.
- The tool change lifts Z before `T<n> M6`, because the M6 macros are
  the user's: sound, and the refusal text says what to set instead.
- The `dwellInMilliseconds` option converts P once, in one function.
  G91.1 in the header pins the arc-centre mode. Both are fine.
- The shared post tables carry `mach3` (conformance, comp, dwell, bore,
  end units, declared options) and the recorded goldens pin the cycle
  forms. Body, Changelog line, decision file, `Fixes #2482`: present.
  The issue is `in-review` with the author assigned.
- The one gate failure in the body is the old red main of #2483, which
  is closed; that suite is green on `main` now.

Why it was not built:
- The author is not a collaborator. The test runner refuses code from a
  fork by rule, and no local build is authorized for a review of this
  kind. The diff reaches the post and app heavy lanes; those were not
  run here.

State notes:
- The PR conflicts with `main` (GitHub says CONFLICTING now). The
  `conflicts` label is true. The author should merge `main` into the
  branch (`/resolve-conflicts` route, keep both sides); a gate on the
  merged tree, with the reached heavy lanes, is owed before the merge,
  because the diff posts new G-code (safety floor).

This pull request is now a draft. The branch takes on new work after the merge with main.

Main changed the note contract in pull request #3087. Each post script must route header notes through `onComment`. The script `assets/posts/mach3.cps` in this pull request does not do it yet. The test `comment_escape` also counts 21 post scripts now, not 20.

We add these two one-line fixes in a refresh commit on top of the merge with main. This is a DELTA refresh. A delta review of the remerge-diff follows the push. The fixes match the pattern of the other 20 post scripts on main, one for one.

Maintainer decision, 2026-11-22, given in the question dialog: **merge after the refresh, a delta read and a green trial merge with current `main`.** It is a feat, so it merges when it is reviewed and gated, not at the next cut.

Thank you to the contributor for this post. The coordinator does the refresh (the `onComment` routing of #3087 and the post count in `comment_escape`).

Coordinator: two label corrections on head 7a44d6fa4.

1. `conflicts` is removed. GitHub reports that this head merges with `main` (`mergeable=MERGEABLE`) after the refresh commits 32b88a704, b0ec8993a and 7a44d6fa4.
2. `needs-maintainer` is removed. It was set again at 16:47Z with no comment and no named reason. The recorded decision stands (comment of 16:40Z, "Maintainer decision, 2026-11-22, given in the question dialog: **merge after the refresh, a delta read and a green trial merge with current `main`.**"). If you see a change that the decision does not cover, name it in a comment. A label with a named reason stays.

What remains before the merge:
- a delta read of the refresh (the remerge-diff of the two merges of `main`, and the commit 7a44d6fa4); it starts now;
- a quick gate on the trial merge with the current `main`, with the step list from the gate dry-run.

The PR stays a draft until the two are done.

Delta read (read-only, not built) of head 7a44d6fa4. This comment has no review marker. I set `needs-rework`. The PR stays a draft.

Hello @HansFel, thank you for this post. The two blockers below come from changes on `main`, not from your work. We make the fixes on this branch (the maintainer decided that we do the refresh), and we tell you here what we pushed.

## The refresh
- Merge 32b88a704: class DELTA. Eight hunks were resolved by hand (`posting_files.rs`, `after_op.rs`, `conformance.rs`, `control_comp.rs`, `wear_comp.rs`, `comment_escape.rs`, `comp.rs`, `fanuc_post.rs`). In each hunk `main` added one post and this PR added Mach3. The two sides are kept. No line, refusal or safety rule is lost.
- Merge b0ec8993a: class SAME. The remerge-diff is empty.
- Commit 7a44d6fa4: new code. `onComment` has the same form as in the other posts. A note text cannot leave the comment: `commentText` removes `( ) % ; * / ! ~ { } $` and line breaks. The count 21 is correct.

## Blockers
1. Two Mach3 goldens are stale. `main` changed the slot and the zigzag pocket generators and made the goldens of each other post again. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/mach3/pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island.nc` and `slot_wide_channel_rows.nc` are the old programs. The `conformance` test fails on them.
2. A dwell on a `G73` or `G85` cycle is dropped with no message (`assets/posts/mach3.cps`, the PECK and REAM cases). Only the `G83` dwell is refused. `main` has a refusal law for this case, and the other posts refuse it by name. The test `crates/post/tests/g73_g85_dwell_linuxcnc.rs` does not list Mach3.

## Also to correct
3. The script does not set `axisInversion = true` and has no `WcsFlip` note. `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` says that each built-in mill post sets it. The output stays safe, because the engine refuses by name. Mach3 is not in the table of `wcs_flip_dialects.rs`.
4. The PR body says "count 20" and names an old red step.

## Follow-ups (not for this PR)
- `explains = "paren"` is not declared. Explain G-code is refused by name.
- `G86` with zero dwell writes no `P` word. No Mach3 source pins that choice.

## Not checked
I did not build. The quick gate on the trial merge with the current `main` follows the fixes.

Hello @HansFel. We pushed the review fixes to your branch `issue/2482-mach3-post`. It was a plain fast-forward push, with no force-push and no rebase. The new head is `783b33f6f`.

## Commits

1. `2eb78f738`: a merge of `origin/main`. The merge was clean.
2. `8b7c96079` test(post): the two stale Mach3 goldens are made again (`pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island.nc`, `slot_wide_channel_rows.nc`).
   - Only these two files changed.
   - The tool motion is the same as in the `grblhal` goldens of the same parts.
   - The tool motion is the same as in the `mach4` goldens, but Mach3 has one more `G0 X.. Y..` line at the current Z (the first-traverse law). That line does not move the tool to a different position.
3. `d84792b15` fix(app): Mach3 now comes before Heidenhain Klartext in `BUILTINS`. Main lists the mill posts first and Klartext after them. The post names do not change.
4. `ccfe4199e` fix(post): a dwell on `G73` (PECK) or `G85` (REAM) is refused by name.
   - "Using Mach3Mill" 1.84 gives these cycles no P word (10.7.22 and 10.7.24.6).
   - Before this change, the post dropped the dwell with no message.
   - The refusal has the same form as in `grblhal.cps`.
   - `mach3` is in `g73_g85_dwell_linuxcnc.rs`. The two new tests were red before the change and are green after it.
5. `783b33f6f` fix(post): `axisInversion = true`, the inverted-axis notes and the `WcsFlip` note, in the same form as `grblhal.cps`.
   - `mach3` is in `wcs_flip_dialects.rs`, with the new golden `golden/wcs_flip/mach3_x.nc`.
   - An upright machine posts the same bytes as before.

## Test results on 783b33f6f

- `camcraft-post`: `script_mach3`, `comment_escape`, `comp`, `fanuc_post`, `end_units`, `declared_options`, `bore_cycle`, `dwell_cycles_modal_p`, `g73_g85_dwell_linuxcnc`, `wcs_flip_dialects`. All pass.
- `camcraft-app`: `conformance`, `after_op`, `control_comp`, `wear_comp`, `post_spindle_rule_all`, `machine_library`, `mcp_machine_post`, `shipped_from_disk`, `posting_rotaries_first`, `folder_lists`. All pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run yet: the remaining quick-plan steps and the `app heavy` lanes. A gate-runner runs them.

The PR body has a new section "Refresh by the maintainers" with this list. The two follow-ups of the review (`explains`, `G86` with zero dwell) are not in this push.

Ready for a re-check.

**Review of the new commits on head 783b33f6f: no blocker.** Read only. This review did not build. The agent that wrote the commits did not write this review. I removed `needs-rework`. The PR stays a draft until the gates below are green.

## Each commit
- `2eb78f738` (merge of `main`): class SAME. The remerge-diff is empty.
- `8b7c96079` (two Mach3 goldens made again): the motion of the two files is the same as in the grblHAL goldens on `main`, word for word after the dialect words are removed. Against Mach4 there are two dialect differences only: one more `G0 X Y` line at the clearance height (the first traverse), and the end retract `G53 G0 Z0`. Each traverse retracts to Z5 first. Each plunge is a feed move. No rapid moves at cutting depth.
- `d84792b15` (Mach3 before Klartext in `BUILTINS` and `EXTENSIONS`): the order agrees with the test `every_builtin_registry_entry_compiles`. Nothing stores a post by its position. Each lookup is by name. The default post stays Fanuc.
- `ccfe4199e` (a `G73` or `G85` dwell is refused by name): the refusal is the same as in `grblhal.cps`, word for word. PECK and REAM with a dwell above zero get to it. A dwell of zero posts as before. `G82`, `G86` and `G89` write `P` through one helper, in seconds by default. The public manual ("Using Mach3Mill", 10.7.22 and 10.7.24.6) gives no `P` word for `G73` and `G85`.
- `783b33f6f` (`axisInversion`, the inverted-axis notes, the `WcsFlip` note): the form is that of `grblhal.cps`. The new golden `wcs_flip/mach3_x.nc` is a correct mirrored program. `comp: false` is correct: the script refuses `G41` / `G42` by name.

The two blockers and item 3 of the delta read are met.

## Gates
- Run by the author of the fixes on this head: 10 post binaries and 10 app binaries by name (`conformance` 7, `script_mach3` 11, `g73_g85_dwell_linuxcnc` 9, `wcs_flip_dialects` 9 and others), and clippy on the post crate. All green.
- Not run: the other steps of the quick plan (773 steps), and the heavy lanes (207 `app heavy` steps). "Not run" is not a pass.
- Next here: the post crate in full and the posting, catalog and conformance app suites on the trial merge with the current `main`, then the heavy run. The PR becomes ready after them.

Follow-up filed: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3530.

@HansFel no action is needed from you. Thank you for the post.

Hello @HansFel. We merged `main` into this branch again, by the maintainer edit permission. We pushed two commits with a plain fast-forward push (no force-push):

- `4a58e4473`: a merge of `origin/main`. One conflict was in `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`. Main split the post count into text posts and the native Agie post. We kept the two counters of main and set the text-post count to 21, which includes `mach3.cps`. The other files merged without a conflict.
- `dd216d57c`: `mach3.cps` now uses the coincident arc guard (`arcFate`) that main added to each shipped post (#3442). Without it, a sub-micrometre arc posted as a full-circle `G2`/`G3` block. The change is the same as in `grblhal.cps`: 3 lines in `onCircular` and the `arcWord` helper. `mach3` is now in the post table of `coincident_arcs.rs`.

Why: main changed after the last refresh, and the PR did not merge. The arc guard is a safety rule for each shipped post.

Results on head dd216d57c:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: all 125 binaries, 1026 tests pass.
- 15 `camcraft-app` test binaries (`conformance`, `posting`, `golden_cl` and others): all pass. No golden changed.
- clippy on `camcraft-post` (all targets) and on the `camcraft-app` library: clean.

We did not add the repeated-tool rule of #3464 to Mach3. Its tests list named posts only. Issue #3565 keeps that item.

No action is needed from you. Ready for a re-check.

**Delta review of head dd216d57c (the two commits after 783b33f6f): no blocker.** Read only, not built. The agent that wrote the commits did not write this review. The PR stays a draft until the trial run below is green.

## The commits
- `4a58e4473`, a merge of `main`: class DELTA, one hunk resolved by hand, in `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs:321-322`. It keeps the two counters of `main`, with `text_posts` 21 and `native_refusals` 1. The number is correct: the merged tree has 22 post scripts, and one is the native writer. No line of `main` is lost in the tables that the two sides touch (`posting_files.rs`, `conformance.rs`, `after_op`, `control_comp`, `wear_comp`, `comp`, `fanuc_post`): each gets the Mach3 row only. Mach3 is after Mach4 and before Klartext, the order that `every_builtin_registry_entry_compiles` expects.
- `dd216d57c`, new code: the arc guard of #3471 in `assets/posts/mach3.cps` (`arcWord` at line 156, the guard at lines 602-604). It is the guard of `grblhal.cps`, character for character. `arcWord` uses the same formatter as the output, so the comparison is on the words as written, in mm and in inch. The guard is before the I/J form and the R form. The `linear` case writes the end of the arc with its Z, so no XY move comes from it. A full circle posts as an arc. Mach3 is in the table of `coincident_arcs.rs`. Without this commit the merged tree wrote a full circle for a very short arc, and each test was green: a good find.

## Other contracts of main
- Two sections with one tool give the tool call two times, as before. That is slower, not a hazard. The rule of #3464 for Mach3 is in #3565.
- A tilted record is refused by name. No line of the PR has the word "Agie".

## Gates
- By the author of the refresh on this head: the whole post crate (125 binaries, 1026 passed), 15 app binaries by name (`conformance` 7, `golden_cl` 33, `posting` 17, `first_part_programs` 2, `example_catalog` 37 and others), clippy on the post crate and on the app lib.
- Still to run, here, on the trial merge with the current `main`: the app binaries that read each shipped post or the registry (`explain_option`, `smoothing`, `per_op_files`, `default_machine_missing`, `program_units`, `post_serves_kind`, `post_serves_plasma`, `program_entry`, `between_setups`, `coolant`, `coolant_air`, `coolant_followups`), the app lib tests and the ui lib tests (the post picker). The heavy lanes are not a merge condition (#3556).

Follow-up: no `mach3_builtin` test matches `mach4_builtin` (noted on #3530).
